newsitem.title: MEXICO: Britain's Clarke explores Mexican energy prospects.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Clarke explores Mexican energy prospects.

text.p: British Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke met with Mexican Energy Minister Jesus Reyes Heroles on Friday and said British firms would be interested in investing in natural gas and power generation in Mexico, the Energy Ministry said.

Mexico has been opening up the two sectors to private investment to improve domestic use of the cleaner energy sources than liquid petroleum gas. Reyes said 10 regions in the country have been defined for private natural gas distribution.
Clarke said Britain is most interested in participating in the energy sectors through debt placements, technical support and regulation aid, the ministry said.

In response to Clarke's concerns over investment opportunities in Mexico's petrochemical industry, the ministry said Reyes explained the strategy in which investors can purchase a minority stake in existing plants and fully own new plants.
Clarke also met Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo, who sought to promote Mexican investment opportunities, a spokesman for the president's office told Reuters.
